nlohmann/json, vendored from [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) release `v3.12.0` (MIT, see `LICENSE.MIT`). Only the single-include headers are kept, from the release's `include.zip` (its `single_include/nlohmann/`).

To update, replace `include/nlohmann/json.hpp`, `include/nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp` and `LICENSE.MIT` from the new release's `include.zip`, and change the release here.
